text:
The experimental work focuses on a polyacrylamide‑titanium dioxide nanocomposite (PAA@TiO₂) that achieves modest adsorption (≈ 38.9 mg g⁻¹) and is characterized by XRD, FT‑IR, SEM‑EDX, MC and MD simulations. None of the presented hypotheses matches this material system, performance level, or mechanistic focus. Consequently, each hypothesis is inconsistent with the study’s evidence.

VERDICT 1: REJECT  
VERDICT 2: REJECT
